WITH invoice_ratios AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(derived_product_cost AS REAL) / NULLIF(derived_total_cost, 0)) AS cost_ratio,
    COUNT(*) AS number_of_line_items
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
)
SELECT
  invoice_number,
  cost_ratio,
  number_of_line_items,
  cost_ratio / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) FROM invoice_ratios), 0) AS relative_ratio
FROM invoice_ratios
WHERE (SELECT AVG(cost_ratio) FROM invoice_ratios) IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
